shots.beat: A begins recounting an awkward office mishap, raising both hands to animate the story, while B smiles across the table and C holds a coffee cup with an attentive grin.

prompt.content: In a quiet café seating area, a rectangular wooden table runs parallel to a window, with a tall floor plant standing directly behind the table's plant-side short end, the café counter located beyond the opposite short end, and an open aisle along the side opposite the window. Seated in the window-side seat nearest the tall floor plant is a person in a mustard-yellow knit sweater with hair styled in a high messy bun, who begins recounting an awkward office mishap by raising both hands to animate the story. Across from the open aisle space, in the window-side seat nearest the café counter, a companion in an emerald-green button-up shirt wearing round tortoiseshell glasses smiles attentively. Meanwhile, an individual in a navy-blue fleece zip jacket with a silver pixie haircut sits at the short-end seat directly in front of the tall floor plant, holding a coffee cup with an attentive grin.
prompt.viewpoint: Static wide shot with a 28mm lens. Place the camera in the open aisle at the counter-side corner of the rectangular table, 1.6 meters high with a slight downward angle, aimed diagonally at the table center. Keep the entire tabletop, both window-side seats, the plant-end seat, the tall floor plant, and the counter-side short end fully inside the frame without cropping any seat.

shots.beat: B leans in curiously to ask a clarifying question, prompting A to shake her head and chuckle in self-deprecating amusement.

prompt.content: The person in the emerald-green button-up shirt wearing round tortoiseshell glasses leans in curiously to ask a clarifying question, prompting the companion in the mustard-yellow knit sweater with her hair in a high messy bun to shake her head and chuckle in self-deprecating amusement.
prompt.viewpoint: Static tight medium two-shot with a 70mm lens. Place the camera in the open aisle directly opposite the two window-side seats at seated eye level, aimed horizontally at that pair. Set the frame edges just outside the pair's outer shoulders; include only the two window-side seats and crop out both short ends of the table and the plant-end seat.

shots.beat: A delivers the punchline with an expressive sigh and an open-palmed shrug, causing B to burst into soft laughter.

prompt.content: The storyteller in the mustard-yellow knit sweater with a high messy bun delivers the punchline with an expressive sigh and an open-palmed shrug, causing the listener in the emerald-green button-up shirt wearing round tortoiseshell glasses to burst into soft laughter.
prompt.viewpoint: Static wide shot with a 28mm lens. Place the camera in the open aisle just beyond the counter-side short end of the rectangular table, 1.7 meters high with a slight downward angle, and aim the optical axis along the table toward the tall floor plant. Keep the entire tabletop from the near counter-side end to the far plant-side end, both window-side seats, and the plant-end seat fully inside the frame; do not crop or obscure the plant-end seat.
